definitely_clear: segment misses expanded box before endpoint bias
measurements: Camera-pair certificates on ALL independent target pixels with baseline geometric eligibility

Upper bound on central eligibility recovery by accepting all ambiguous rays; NOT predicted RGB hits

Independent hidden target pixels with optimistic eligibility; does not establish hidden surface recovery
limitations: Post-hoc bounded analysis on two correlated frames of one previously explored scene, not confirmation/holdout
u is supplied, not estimated; fixed carrier/poses, no rotations, scene-depth, image-filter or calibration uncertainty
Nested box certificates are sufficient bounds; ambiguous does not imply a realizable clear translated box
Accepting ambiguity may restore eligibility while admitting occluded sources; no RGB quality or production mitigation claim
